title: Trustworthy and Responsible AI for Human-Centric Autonomous Decision-Making Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Comprehensive literature review synthesizing theoretical concepts, sources of bias, and fairness evaluation metrics (e.g., Disparate Impact, Demographic Parity, Equal Odds) across various human-centric AI domains.

Reviewing quantitative fairness metrics and bias mitigation techniques (pre-processing, in-processing, and post-processing) used in existing literature to detect and address discrimination based on protected attributes like gender, race, and age.
